notes.notes: Fixed a bug on the first Chief quest when starting a new game and choosing 'Not Much' as your starting loadout.

notes.title: Version 0.5.1.2
notes.notes:
This update adds a new game start procedure. You can now select a difficulty level, choose a character and choose a loadout. This is only available when starting a new game for the first time. I also added rocket launchers and factions will now fight each other if they come into contact. There is also a new faction wandering the wasteland. The reputaion screen has been updated to show the various factions to player relationship status. The town guards have also been updated.

Added

Added weapon info to the target range.
Added enemy factions attacking each other.
Updated the reputation screen to show the relationship toward the player.
Added A new faction.
Added Rocket Launchers and ammo.
Added difficulty setting when starting a new game.
Added character selection when starting a new game.
Added loadout selection when starting a new game.
Added new town guards.

Fixed

Fixed grenade explosions low damage amount.
Fixed a soft lock that can happen when repairing or fuelling a vehicle.
Fixed Ne-5 Auto fire not working.
Fixed the sometimes locked gate on the Zombie experiment quest.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.1.0
notes.notes:
This update brings some changes as well as a lot of fixes to the game. I have begun adding more NPC quests starting with Dr. Serious. The bug that allowed vehicles to spawn in the player hideout should be resolved. If you lose a vehicle while on a raid you can pay a salvage fee to recover it along with some of it's contents.

Added

Added a ‘Footsteps’ volume audio setting.

Added footsteps to NPCs in town.

Added Guard dogs.

Added two new zombie types and attacks.

Added new buildings to the Abandoned Town map. More buildings are in the works.

Added a salvage option to the chief. You can now pay a salvage fee to return a lost vehicle.

Added more quests for Dr. Serious. I hope to add many more.

Cleaned up the end of raid stats page.

Vehicles now move faster on road than off road.

Added deeper water.

Added a basement with a target range to the player hideout. I hope to add weapon stats here later.

Changed the player start position when beginning a new game.

Fixed

Fixed a bug that could cause Crater Town quests to not activate properly.

Fixed map scrolling on monitors above 1080p.

Fixed zombies colliding with cacti. Removed the large cactus collision box.

Fixed being able to drive two vehicles at the same time.

Fixed NPCs erratic movements, walking in place and walking on their sides.

Fixed the required crafting items list on 4k displays. Items no longer overlap.

Fixed consuming quest items could lead to a crash when trying to claim a quest reward.

Fixed missing quest dialog.

Fixed the scale of the hit blood splash on the screen border when hit.

Fixed a bug when selecting the shop buy ammo button without a magazine in the primary weapon.

Fixed rain not starting again after leaving a building.

Fixed unable to shoot knocked out enemies.

Fixed a bug that allowed enemies to move fast in water.

Fixed a crash when unloading a magazine from an equipped weapon into a full backpack. The magazine will be placed on the ground.

Fixed ammo disappearing when unloading a magazine into a full rig. The ammo will be placed on the ground.

Fixed shop items on the buy table disappearing when exiting the shop.

notes.title: Version 0.5.0.6 Melee and Controller update.
notes.notes:
Update 0.5.0.6 adds controller support and introduces melee weapons. You can buy melee weapons and attachments from the repair shop. As some of you may remember the old demo had controller support but it was disabled for the early access release. This update returns controller support. It took a lot of work to get it back up and running and there is still more work to be done but I must admit it is pretty fun to kick back with the gamepad and blast zombies. Future improvements will include better navigation of the inventory and adding gamepad settings such as changing the cross hair travel distance.

With the controller and melee weapons in the game the next few updates will be content focused. More buildings, more items, more quests and another area to explore.

I hope everyone is enjoying playing Atomic Exile. I'm having a ton of fun building it.



Added.

Controller support.

Melee weapons.

Reworked the small start town gas station where enemies could attack unseen.

A button to un-track all recipes.

It is now possible to shoot over concrete barriers.

Known Issues.

Issues with some monitors that are not 16x9.

Vehicles appearing in your hideout. This is my favourite.

Healing from the quick use slots should heal the weakest body part first.

notes.title: Patch. June 29 2025
notes.notes:
Version 0.5.0.2 brings a change to the quick swap system as well as needed bug fixes.


 Fixed. Quick swapping an empty tote could lead to the item disappearing.
 Fixed. Rotate bug causing items to get overlapped and crash the inventory.
 Fixed. Stairs ‘teleport’ bug. Climbing back up stairs could lead to the player emerging in a different building.
 Fixed. Quick swapping an attachment from a weapon with no equipped backpack bug.
 Fixed. Tutorial typos.
 Starting from an empty save slot will now save immediately to prevent a possible save conflict.
 Saves are now only done when the player is in town. This is to prevent a possible save conflict.

Added.

 Improved the inventory quick swap. The target quick swap inventory is now highlighted. To target an inventory for quick swap click on it or drag an item onto it.
 Enemies will investigate noises.
 Zombies can now be thrown and stunned by explosions. They will get back up if only stunned.
 Added a message and icon reminding players when they have left an item on the workbench.

The next update will be focused more on content. Mainly more buildings and places to explore for the existing maps. Bugs noted by players such as the crafting and quick use bug are also on the to do list and should be fixed soon.

notes.title: Atmomic Exile Demo patch 0.7.

A quick patch to fix issues with the player health system.

Remember you can always heal your character by dragging and dropping med kits directly onto the injured limb on the player diagram. This way if your character has a wouned leg and is moving slowly you can prioritize this injury and get back to normal movement speed.
